scope: Keep the retained heroic jewelry loot while translating its generated NGE weapon action-cost expertise roll to the corresponding Publish 14.1 weapon-speed skill modifier consumed by the authoritative PRE-CU cadence path.

findings: Publish 14.1 attack cadence sums the weapon template's category speed modifiers plus the authored private and generic melee/ranged speed modifiers; it has no weapon action-cost expertise statistic.
The restored x64 command queue maps the ten retained jewelry categories to their authenticated Publish 14.1 *_speed modifiers and consumes the enhanced modifier in calculatePrecuAttackTime.

The inherited heroic jewelry generator produced expertise_action_weapon_<type>, which is consumed only by the later non-PRE-CU action-cost path and therefore had no valid authority under the restored three-pool HAM cost model.
All twenty-six jewelry definitions and all seventy-two heroic loot-table placements are retained content; only the generated weapon-efficiency modifier is translated.

buildEvidence.focusedJavaCompile: passed in an ephemeral in-memory directory that was removed immediately; bytecode retained all ten PRE-CU speed modifiers and contained no expertise_action_weapon symbol

auditBoundary.closedInThisMilestone: New retained heroic jewelry can no longer seed an NGE weapon action-cost expertise statistic; its weighted weapon roll now participates in the authoritative PRE-CU attack-speed calculation.
auditBoundary.preserved: All jewelry templates, names, item-table rows, heroic loot placements, delayed one-time initialization, two existing primary-stat rolls, +25/+25/+2 magnitudes, and the original ranged/melee/lightsaber weighting remain unchanged.
auditBoundary.notClaimedComplete: The two inherited NGE primary-stat rolls require a separate authenticated translation; other retained content-specific expertise references remain subject to later production-reachability audits.

requiredBeforeReady: Pass a clean full Java and x64 server build from the pushed direct-source pin.
Authenticate source/work parity and the emitted heroic jewelry class.
Restart the server, observe the player-ready marker, verify the mapped x64 binary, and audit post-start logs.
